veranderings.voor: Sowat 2 000 jaar gelede het mense hier in die Later Steentydperk ook begin
veranderings.na: Sowat 2 000 jaar gelede, in die Later Steentydperk, het mense hier ook begin
veranderings.rede: 'hier in die Later Steentydperk' runs a place word straight into a time phrase and reads as if the Stone Age were a place; setting the time phrase off keeps the meaning and reads smoothly.
The sentence means telling the two groups apart, which is 'onderskei'; 'skei' means to separate them physically.
